userStories.story: Set up project structure and configure dev environment
userStories.acceptance: RUN "pipenv install click rich pytest" - Successful execution without errors, project folder exists with necessary files

userStories.story: Implement base classes and interfaces for parsers, analyzers, and reporters
steps: Create abstract base class for parser
userStories.acceptance: RUN "pytest" - BaseParser exists and throws NotImplementedError, ApacheParser implements necessary methods

userStories.story: Implement CLI interface for parsing and analyzing logs
steps: Create main function with click decorators
Add commands for parse and analyze
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens --help" - Shows help text, includes parse and analyze commands

userStories.story: Implement parsing of Apache logs
steps: Use regex to match and extract fields from log lines
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens parse access.log --format apache" - Outputs parsed entries, one per line

userStories.story: Implement generation of HTML reports
steps: Create abstract base class for reporter
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --output report.html" - Creates report.html, opens in browser

userStories.story: Implement parsing of JSON logs
steps: Use json library to parse log lines
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens parse access.json --format json" - Outputs parsed entries, one per line

userStories.story: Implement time range filtering for logs
steps: Add --from and --to options to CLI commands
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --from 2024-01-01 00:00:00" - Outputs entries from specified time range

userStories.story: Implement error filtering for logs
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --errors-only" - Outputs only entries with errors

userStories.story: Implement real-time monitoring for logs
steps: Create tail command that follows log file
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens tail access.log" - Outputs new lines as they appear, includes --alert-on-errors option

userStories.story: Implement generation of CSV reports
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --output report.csv" - Creates report.csv, opens in Excel

userStories.story: Implement generation of JSON reports
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --output report.json" - Creates report.json, validates with jsonschema

userStories.story: Implement export to SQLite database
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --output report.db" - Creates report.db, loadable in sqlite3

userStories.story: Implement parsing of Syslog logs
steps: Use regex to match and extract fields from log lines
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens parse syslog.log --format syslog" - Outputs parsed entries, one per line

userStories.story: Allow custom log formats via YAML config file
steps: Create command to generate custom format config
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens add-format my_format 'regex pattern'" - Generates my_format.yaml, parses logs with regex pattern

userStories.story: Implement error rate threshold for alerts in real-time monitoring
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens tail access.log --alert-on-errors" - Alert when error rate exceeds specified threshold

userStories.story: Implement integration with Prometheus and Grafana for advanced metrics
steps: Use Prometheus client library to expose metrics
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --output prometheus" - Exposes metrics in Prometheus format, accessible in Grafana

userStories.story: Implement distributed log analysis across multiple files
steps: Modify CLI to accept list of files
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze file1.log file2.log" - Outputs combined analysis of all files

userStories.story: Implement cloud storage support for log files (S3, GCS)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze s3://bucket/file.log" - Analyzes logs from S3 bucket

userStories.story: Implement REST API for log analysis
steps: Use Flask to create REST API
userStories.acceptance: RUN "curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/analyze -d @logfile.txt" - Outputs JSON report in response

userStories.story: Implement anomaly detection for logs
steps: Use machine learning library to detect anomalies
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --detect-anomalies" - Outputs entries with detected anomalies

userStories.story: Implement auto-update of log formats from central repository
steps: Create command to update local format config
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens update-formats" - Updates local format config, applies new formats to logs

userStories.story: Implement auto-update of log analysis algorithms from central repository
steps: Create command to update local analysis algorithm config
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens update-algorithms" - Updates local analysis algorithm config, applies new algorithms to logs

userStories.story: Implement user management system for access control
steps: Use Flask-Security to create user management system
userStories.acceptance: RUN "curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/users -d '{"username":"user1","password":"pass1"}'" - Creates new user, requires authentication for log analysis commands

userStories.story: Implement role-based access control for log analysis commands
steps: Use Flask-Security to implement role-based access control
userStories.acceptance: RUN "curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/roles -d '{"name":"admin","description":"Can analyze all logs"}'" - Creates new role, assigns permissions to commands
userStories.verify: pytest && curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/roles -d '{"name":"admin","description":"Can analyze all logs"}'

userStories.story: Implement audit logging for all log analysis commands
steps: Use Flask-Audit to implement audit logging
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log" - Logs command execution, includes user and timestamp

userStories.story: Implement support for log levels (INFO, WARN, ERROR)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-level INFO" - Outputs only entries with specified log level

userStories.story: Implement support for log categories
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-category security" - Outputs only entries with specified log category

userStories.story: Implement support for log timestamps (before, after)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-timestamp before 2024-01-01 00:00:00" - Outputs entries with timestamps before specified time

userStories.story: Implement support for log durations (last hour, last day)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-duration last_hour" - Outputs entries with timestamps in last hour

userStories.story: Implement support for log search (by message, by field)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-search 'error code 500'" - Outputs entries with specified text in message

userStories.story: Implement support for log sorting (by timestamp, by field)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-sort timestamp" - Outputs entries sorted by timestamp

userStories.story: Implement support for log pagination (by page number)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-page 2" - Outputs entries on specified page

userStories.story: Implement support for log filtering (by field value)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-filter 'error_code=500'" - Outputs entries with specified field value

userStories.story: Implement support for log aggregation (by count, by field)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-aggregate error_code" - Outputs entries aggregated by specified field

userStories.story: Implement support for log grouping (by field)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-group error_code" - Outputs entries grouped by specified field

userStories.story: Implement support for log transformations (by field)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-transform 'error_code=int(error_code)'" - Outputs entries with specified field transformed

userStories.story: Implement support for log formatting (as table, as JSON)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-format json" - Outputs entries in specified format

userStories.story: Implement support for log visualization (as bar chart, as pie chart)
userStories.acceptance: RUN "loglens analyze access.log --log-visualize bar_chart" - Outputs entries visualized in specified format
